en-US.summary: Control your apartment thermostat with voice commands
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask my apartment to set temperature to 72
Alexa, tell my apartment to make it warmer
Alexa, ask my apartment what's the temperature
en-US.name: My Apartment
en-US.description: Control your apartment's thermostat, submit maintenance requests, and get building information using voice commands. Perfect for hands-free climate control!

publishingInformation.testingInstructions:
1. Link your account with unit number
2. Try: 'Alexa, ask my apartment to set temperature to 72'
3. Try: 'Alexa, tell my apartment it's too cold'
